label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
diagnostic_questions: Does the existing 50000-resample implementation reproduce byte-for-byte or numerically within the frozen tolerance?
Are items, all 32 fresh conditions, both rollouts, and paired historical-reference profiles resampled together in frozen item order?
Does ordinary n-out-of-n resampling reduce effective support, induce ties, or attenuate compound Dshape-to-Spearman statistics?
Is the observed displacement explained by estimator nonlinearity and finite-support perturbation, by implementation error, or by failure of percentile-bootstrap calibration?
Which candidate item-level uncertainty methods are calibrated in model-free simulations for the exact structural dimensions and R=2 regime?
What uncertainty population does each method target?

B_bayesian_multiplier.weights: independent Exponential(1) normalized to mean one
B_bayesian_multiplier.role: continuous item-weight perturbation with full item support

C_subsampling_without_replacement.calibration: center at the full-sample estimate and scale deviations by sqrt(m/N) for diagnostic interval construction
C_subsampling_without_replacement.role: finite-support sensitivity; each item appears at most once

D_delete_d_item_jackknife.role: item-level smoothness and bias diagnostic with explicit deleted-item estimand

E_controller_cluster_bootstrap.role: separate controller-population uncertainty object; never a replacement for item uncertainty

simulation_protocol.parallelism: deterministic panel-level CPU parallelism permitted; result order restored before aggregation

primary_object_integrity_requires: fresh and historical item ordering match exactly
centering_bias_reported_as: absolute difference between resampling median and full-sample estimand
signed mean resampling error relative to known simulation truth
evaluation_criteria.coverage_report: point estimate plus Wilson 95% interval across outer panels
evaluation_criteria.calibration_screen: coverage point estimate in [0.90,0.99], absolute centering bias <=0.05, and degeneracy <=0.01
evaluation_criteria.ties: report exact and rounded rank-tie frequencies; never jitter or break ties randomly
method_selection_precedence: coverage across null, positive, heterogeneous, sparse, and heavy-tie scenarios

interpretation_rules.implementation_defect: any frozen coupling, ordering, duplicate-weighting, Dshape, statistic, seed, or quantile invariant fails
interpretation_rules.method_not_calibrated: implementation is exact but ordinary percentile intervals fail the frozen calibration screen in at least two structurally relevant scenarios
interpretation_rules.implementation_clean_interpretation_reca: implementation is exact and the displacement is structurally explained; terminology is changed only if simulation shows the object targets panel perturbation rather than conventional confidence coverage
interpretation_rules.unresolved: available simulations and algebra do not distinguish implementation, nonregularity, and finite-support attenuation with sufficient confidence
